neet_phy_u14_t04_1.working: An ammeter reads the rms value, so I0 = √2 × 5 = 7.07 A.

neet_phy_u14_t04_2.working: The half-cycle mean is 2I0/π = 14, so I0 = 14π/2 = 7 × 22/7 = 22 A. Then Irms = 22/√2 ≈ 15.6 A.

neet_phy_u14_t04_4.working: For the square wave, I² = I0² at all times, so Irms = I0 and A is true. R is also true, but it concerns the sinusoidal case and does not explain A.

neet_phy_u14_t04_5.working: Statement I: the mean over a full cycle is 0, so I is false. Statement II: rms/mean = (I0/√2)/(2I0/π) = π/(2√2) ≈ 1.11. The value 0.90 is mean/rms, so II is false.
